# Sources this skill cites

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-equity-limited-sources

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. C.2.a: limited equity sources, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** Limited sources (standby debt, standby seller debt, minority equity investments) may supply no more than half of the required equity.
- **Quote:** "Limited Equity Injection Sources: The following sources, whether individually or in the aggregate, may provide no more than half of the required Equity Injection."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-max-loan

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section B, Ch. 1: maximum Standard 7(a) loan, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** The largest Standard 7(a) loan is $5 million.

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-other-guarantors

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 5, Para. A: other guarantors, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** The lender may require guaranties from others regardless of ownership percentage.
- **Quote:** "When deemed necessary for credit or other reasons, SBA or, for a loan processed on a delegated basis, the SBA Lender, may require other appropriate individuals or entities to provide full or limited guaranties of the loan without regard to the percentage of their ownership interests, if any."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-pari-passu

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. C.3: pari passu is not piggyback, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** A non-SBA loan sharing the lien equally with the 7(a) loan is allowed if its maturity is not shorter than the 7(a) loan.
- **Quote:** "SBA does not consider a shared lien position with the lender (pari passu) to be a piggyback structure when the maturity of the non-SBA guaranteed loan is not shorter than the maturity of the SBA-guaranteed loan."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-personal-guaranty

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 5, Para. A: personal guaranties, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** Every individual owning 20% or more of the borrower must give an unlimited full personal guaranty.
